content: ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🚀 LEONARDO SAEZ WILCHES | Data Engineer & Game Dev ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ I am the Founder & Lead Data Engineer at Contactall and a final-year Computer Science student at Pontificia Universidad Javeriana Cali. ─── TECHNICAL FOCUS ─────────────────────────────────────────── • BIG DATA: Scalable Pipelines, PySpark, Hadoop & Snowflake. • CLOUD: Architecting robust solutions on AWS. • INTERACTIVE: Game Development & Software Innovation. ─── BEYOND THE TERMINAL ─────────────────────────────────────── • COMMUNICATION: Studying Sign Language & Dramatic Arts. • RITUALS: Reading novels, cycling, and discovering music. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CONTACT & SOCIAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Email: leonardosawi12@gmail.com ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
